name: prompt_learn_classify
description: Prompt-learning image classifier: learn the label set from a labelled training set, then classify every image in a validation set one-by-one against a task description. Generic - labels, class count and validation size are all derived from the inputs, never hard-coded. Output is the per-image answer string '<i><LABEL>' joined by commas in numeric order.

task_description.description: The question's task/classification rule, verbatim. The model uses this as the decision rule for every validation image.

train_dir.description: Name (or path) of the training-set directory declared in the question (e.g. the labelled set). Relative names resolve against the question directory. Optional; inferred from the question's files when omitted.

val_dir.description: Name (or path) of the validation-set directory to classify (unlabelled). Relative names resolve against the question directory. Optional; inferred from the question's files when omitted.

few_shot_k.description: Number of training examples (balanced across classes) to attach as few-shot exemplars to each prompt. Defaults to 0 (zero-shot).
